listening.title: Presenting the Numbers to the Boss

lines.speaker: Hai
lines.text: Thu, I've prepared the executive summary for this month's report.

lines.speaker: Thu
lines.text: Good, let's take a look. Did you include a data visualization for revenue?

lines.speaker: Hai
lines.text: Yes, there's a chart on page two, plus supporting data in the appendix slide.

lines.speaker: Thu
lines.text: I like that. Can we do a quick sanity check on the total cost?

lines.speaker: Hai
lines.text: Sure, I already reviewed it twice and the numbers match our ledger.

lines.speaker: Thu
lines.text: Great. What's the narrative behind the drop in April?

lines.speaker: Hai
lines.text: It was mainly due to a delayed client payment, not a real warning sign.

lines.speaker: Thu
lines.text: Good to know. Keep this as a one-pager for the leadership meeting.

lines.speaker: Hai
lines.text: Understood, I'll trim it down to the key points only.

lines.speaker: Thu
lines.text: Perfect, send it to me by tomorrow morning.
